Wastewater surveillance is one of our strongest early warning systems to get ahead of infectious disease outbreaks.

Wastewater Action Alliance Executive Director Kate Hull highlights the critical role this tool plays and the need to keep it available with my PREDICT Act.

Today we celebrate the stars and stripes that have represented the greatest nation on earth since the adoption of the U.S. flag in 1777. Happy Flag Day!

Once again, @POTUS proves he is the Dealmaker in Chief. When America leads with strength, we get results. A major victory for American security and global stability!


The White House (@WhiteHouse)

“The Deal with Islamic Republic of Iran is now complete. Congratulations to all!” President Donald J. Trump 🇺🇸

Join me in lifting Senator McConnell in prayer for a swift recovery. Grateful to hear he is receiving excellent care from his medical team, and we look forward to seeing him in the Senate halls soon.

Happy birthday, @POTUS!

Thank you, Mr. President, for bringing our country back into the Golden Age.

Happy 251st birthday to the @USArmy!

Today we honor the men and women who answer the call to serve. God bless our soldiers and their families!
A pleasure to meet with Taiwan’s Representative to the U.S. Alexander Yui to discuss the importance of U.S.-Taiwanese partnerships in security and trade!

It was great to meet with CDC Director nominee, Dr. Erica Schwartz! From her role as Chief Medical Officer in the U.S. Coast Guard to her focus on prevention, early detection, and public health readiness, Dr. Schwartz has the experience and insight to protect and improve public health.

The African American Civil Rights Network not only helps preserve our nation’s history but also strengthens our local economies through cultural tourism. As home to the largest share of AACRN sites in the country, South Carolina proves the immense value of reauthorizing this program and making sure future generations can walk these historic grounds, learn from our past, and continue striving for a future where the promise of the American Dream is within reach for all! scott.senate.gov/media-cent

Innovation shouldn’t be held back by uncertainty.

The Clarity Act establishes clear guardrails and transparency, helping create new opportunities to achieve the American Dream. Clarity for digital assets and your future.

Women have long played an important role in our nation’s armed forces. This Women Veterans Day, I'd like to highlight South Carolina’s Arlene Burch. Arlene is a Korean War veteran who'll be celebrating her 100th birthday this summer!

Thank you for your service, Arlene, and for the sacrifices made by you and the many women who have served in the U.S. military.

The U.S. Coast Guard Cutter Barque Eagle will be in Charleston from June 11- 14th.

Captain Ensley and his crew have brought the only square-rigged sailing ship in U.S. government service to the Union Pier Cruise Terminal and it is free and open to public tours!

Video

President Trump made an excellent choice in nominating Jay Clayton as Director of National Intelligence. Having voted for him in the past to lead the SEC, I’m confident he has the experience, judgment, and resolve needed to lead and coordinate our intelligence efforts here at home and around the world. Let’s get him confirmed!

Extreme heat conditions are expected across the Carolinas this weekend. Remember to stay hydrated, limit time outdoors, and check on your neighbors!


NWS Charleston, SC (@NWSCharlestonSC)

Oppressive heat continues throughout the weekend, with heat index values near 105-112° 🥵 Heat Advisories will likely be needed, especially across the coastal corridor. 

We encourage you to stay hydrated, limit time outdoors, and take frequent breaks in the shade/AC!







— https://nitter.net/NWSCharlestonS

The @FIFAWorldCup Tournament is officially here! The U.S. is proud to welcome fans from across the world.

Good luck Team USA, we'll be cheering you on! 🇺🇸⚽

Americans deserve accountability and responsible stewardship of their taxpayer dollars.

New York and Governor Hochul have failed to deliver both, allowing more than $600 million in improper unemployment benefit payments.

Every dollar lost to fraud is a dollar taken away from hardworking Americans. nypost.com/2026/06/11/us-new…

AI should empower American workers, not replace them.

Combined with the talent, grit, and ingenuity of the American workforce, AI can boost productivity, raise incomes, and create more opportunity.

Video

Digital assets are part of the future of finance. We can either lead the next era of innovation or be left watching it happen elsewhere.

America doesn't follow - we lead.
